faqMini.subtitle: Short answers to the questions every business asks first
faqMini.stillText: Talk to us and we will walk your business through it — what goes into the system, what runs on its own, and where to start
faqMini.ctaTitle: Ready to manage your business in one place?
faqMini.ctaText: Build your business workspace with CRM, collaborations, appointments and AI.
faqMini.a1Lead: Bizuply is an all-in-one platform that centralizes your business — business page, CRM, collaborations, and AI — so you can manage everything in one place.
faqMini.a1b1Text: Turn visitors into leads with a professional profile.
faqMini.a1b2Text: Track leads, clients, follow-ups, and pipeline stages.
faqMini.a1b3Text: Work with other businesses and manage proposals & deals.
faqMini.a1b4Text: Get smart suggestions and next-step actions to move faster.
faqMini.a1Footer: Everything stays connected — no more switching between scattered tools.
faqMini.q2: How does Bizuply help me get more clients?
faqMini.a2Lead: Bizuply helps you capture leads, respond faster, and stay consistent — which increases conversions over time.
faqMini.a2b1Text: Your business page turns traffic into inquiries.
faqMini.a2b2Text: CRM reminders and tasks keep leads warm.
faqMini.a2b3Text: A clear pipeline view helps you move opportunities forward.
faqMini.a2Footer: The result: fewer missed messages, faster follow-ups, and more closed clients.
faqMini.q3: What can I manage inside the CRM?
faqMini.a3Lead: Your CRM is where everything about a lead or client stays organized — so you always know what’s next.
faqMini.a3b1Text: Keep every contact and inquiry in one place.
faqMini.a3b2Text: Set reminders, next steps, and due dates.
faqMini.a3b3Text: Track conversations, status, and progress over time.
faqMini.a3b4Text: Move deals through steps so nothing gets stuck.
faqMini.a3Footer: No more spreadsheets or forgotten follow-ups — it’s all structured and searchable.
faqMini.q4: How does AI help in Bizuply?
faqMini.a4Lead: Bizuply AI helps you act faster by highlighting priorities and recommending next steps based on your activity.
faqMini.a4b1Text: Get recommended actions for leads and deals.
faqMini.a4b2Text: See what needs attention now — before it’s too late.
faqMini.a4b3Text: Draft better replies and follow-ups in less time.
faqMini.a4Footer: It’s like having a smart assistant inside your CRM — focused on results.
faqMini.q5: How does website & store building work?
faqMini.a5Lead: Pick a ready template, edit design and content, publish — and site forms land straight in your CRM lead pipeline.
faqMini.a5b1Text: 200+ ready templates for businesses, stores and services.
faqMini.a5b2Text: Change text, images and colors with no code.
faqMini.a5b3Text: Every inquiry from the site becomes a lead in the system.
faqMini.a5Footer: A professional site that brings customers — inside the same system that manages them.
faqMini.q6: What do automations do in Bizuply?
faqMini.a6Lead: Automations run reminders, follow-ups and alerts in the background — so fewer leads fall through the cracks.
faqMini.a6b1Text: The system reminds you to follow up at the right time.
faqMini.a6b2Text: Follow-up sequences that keep leads warm.
faqMini.a6b3Text: Get notified when something needs attention now.
faqMini.a6Footer: Less manual work — more leads that reach a close.

advisor.welcome:
Hi 👋 I'm your **Business Advisor**.

I analyze system data and recommend what to do — leads to handle, follow-up drafts, campaign improvements, rep performance, and more.

I **do not execute actions** in the system. Advanced automatic actions are in the **AI Automations** tab.

modePrompts.today_focus: What should I do today based on my business data? Give a clear priority list for leads, appointments, tasks, and opportunities — without executing actions.
modePrompts.leads_attention: Which leads need attention now? Rank by urgency, explain why, and recommend what to say or do next.
modePrompts.sales_drop: Why did sales drop based on system data? Give a short diagnosis and practical corrective recommendations.
modePrompts.followup_message: Draft a ready-to-copy follow-up message for a relevant lead or customer based on my data.
modePrompts.campaign_improve: Give campaign improvement recommendations based on my data. Do not change campaigns — advice only.
modePrompts.reps_performance: Analyze my reps' performance based on system data and recommend improvements.
modePrompts.build_automation: Help me design an automation from this conversation: define trigger, conditions, and recommended actions. Explain that it can be enabled in Automations / AI Automations.
modePrompts.find_business_partner: Find me a suitable business partner from businesses in the system. Review existing businesses, check fit by field, services, area, target audience, business potential, and whether they are complementary or competing. Return a list of recommended businesses with match percentage, why each fits, what value they can give me, what value I can give them, and finish with a ready outreach message.
modePrompts.weekly_plan: Build me a business advisory plan for the coming week based on my business data. Include goals, daily actions, ready templates, and success metrics. Do not execute actions in the system.
modePrompts.monthly_plan: Build me a monthly business growth plan. Include weekly breakdown, marketing, sales, customer retention, operations, goals, and metrics.
modePrompts.yearly_plan: Build me a structured annual business plan. Include goals, quarterly breakdown, actions per quarter, success metrics, and what to start doing now.
modePrompts.marketing: Build me a focused marketing plan for the business based on my data. Recommend what to promote, who to reach, which offer to run, and provide ready WhatsApp messages and posts to copy.
modePrompts.actions: Analyze my business and give me a prioritized list for today. Write what to do, why it matters, and how to execute — without executing in the system.
modePrompts.profitability: Analyze my business profitability and pricing. Recommend which services to promote, where to increase value, which packages to create, and what to check before changing prices.
modePrompts.customer_retention: Build me a customer retention and win-back plan. Write who to contact, when, which messages to send, and how to turn one-time customers into repeat customers.

advisor.promptRules:
You are BizUply Business Advisor — advice only.

Rules:
- Answer in English only.
- If the question is short, answer briefly and to the point.
- If a plan was requested, build a structured, professional plan.
- Do not invent data that is not in the system.
- Every recommendation must become a clear next step the owner can take.
- Do not execute actions in the system and never claim you did.
- Automatic actions belong to AI Automations.

appointmentCrm.whyBothTitle: Why businesses need both an appointment calendar and a CRM
appointmentCrm.whyBothP1: Service-based businesses often operate in more than one environment. Services may be delivered at a fixed location such as a clinic or office, and also at the customer’s home or another external location. To support that flexibility, appointment scheduling and customer management must work together.
appointmentCrm.whyBothP2: The appointments calendar is a customer-facing tool that lets people see real-time availability and book independently — whether the service is at your location or at theirs. That reduces scheduling friction, removes unnecessary back-and-forth, and improves the booking experience.
appointmentCrm.whyBothP3: The CRM, on the other hand, is an internal management system. It lets you track individual customers, store contact details, and document inquiries and service history over time. That information is essential for personalized service, better retention, and targeted marketing campaigns.
appointmentCrm.whyNotOutsideTitle: Why not manage scheduling outside Bizuply?
appointmentCrm.whyNotOutsideP1: Some businesses rely on external tools like Google Calendar, paper diaries, or disconnected systems for appointments. While that may seem convenient, it creates risks and limitations:
whyNotOutsideItems: Lack of sync can cause duplicate appointments, schedule conflicts, and missed opportunities.
Double management increases administrative load and the risk of human error.
Customer data gets scattered, making it hard to track history, inquiries, and reviews in one place.
Marketing and retention suffer without a unified data source for segmentation and analysis.
appointmentCrm.howTogetherTitle: How the appointment calendar and CRM work together in Bizuply
appointmentCrm.howTogetherP1: Bizuply provides a fully integrated system. When a customer books an appointment — whether at the business location or at home — the booking is recorded immediately in the calendar and synced in real time.
appointmentCrm.howTogetherP2: At the same time, the customer profile in the CRM is updated with appointment details, including service history and past interactions. All relevant information stays in one place, enabling accurate planning and consistent service.
benefits: Significant time savings through centralized scheduling and customer management.

Data-driven marketing and retention based on real customer activity.
Flexible management of services across multiple locations.

chat.g2Line2: Provide a clear, concise explanation of the solution:
chat.g2Quote2: “The service includes a full facial treatment, takes approximately one hour, and is tailored to your needs.”
chat.g2Line3: End with a clear next step:

chat.g3Line2: Fast responses increase satisfaction and close rates.

chat.ex1You: “Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out. We offer several natural and personalized facial treatments. Would you like an overview or should I check upcoming availability?”
chat.ex2Title: Example 2: Explaining a service and pricing
chat.ex2You: “Our standard facial includes deep cleansing, gentle exfoliation, facial massage, and calming masks. The session lasts about one hour and costs $290. Would you like me to check available times?”
chat.ex3Customer: Customer: “That sounds expensive. Do you have a more affordable option?”
chat.ex3You: “I understand. We also offer a shorter 45-minute facial at a lower price of $180. I’d be happy to explain the differences and find a suitable option for you.”
chat.ex4Title: Example 4: Closing with a clear call to action
chat.ex4You: “Great. I currently have availability on Wednesday at 10:00 AM and Thursday at 4:00 PM. Which works better for you?”
chat.ex5Customer: Customer: “I wasn’t satisfied with the last treatment.”
chat.ex5You: “I’m sorry to hear that. Your satisfaction is important to me, and I’d like to understand what happened so we can find the best solution. Would you prefer a follow-up session or a clarification call?”

summaryItems: Use the customer’s name to personalize communication.
Offer focused solutions with clear explanations.
Ask open-ended questions to understand customer needs.
End conversations with a clear next step.
Maintain a professional and respectful tone.
Use conversation history to improve service quality.

websiteBuilding.title: FAQ — Website building
websiteBuilding.subtitle: Answers to common questions about creating, editing, and publishing websites in Bizuply

createSite.question: How do I create a new website in Bizuply?
createSite.answer:
From the Dashboard go to "Website Building" → "My Sites" → click "New site".

You can choose:
• Ready-made template — pick a design from the gallery and continue to editing
• Build with AI — answer short questions and AI will build the site for you

After choosing, the site opens in the visual editor for editing and publishing.

templateVsAi.question: What is the difference between a ready-made template and building with AI?
templateVsAi.answer:
Ready-made template:
• Best if you want full control over design from the start
• Pick a design from the gallery and adapt content and colors

Build with AI:
• Best if you want to start quickly
• Answer questions about the business, services, and style
• AI creates structure, initial content, design, and SEO settings
• The site opens in the editor ready to edit

editSite.question: How do I edit the site in the visual editor?
editSite.answer:
Open the site from "My Sites" → "Edit".

In the editor you can:
• Drag and change sections, text, images, and buttons
• Change colors, fonts, and style
• Add or remove sections (services, testimonials, FAQ, and more)
• Edit SEO settings
• Preview before publishing

Remember to save after every meaningful change.

publish.question: How do I publish the website?
publish.answer:
After finishing editing, click "Publish" in the editor.

Bizuply will create a unique address (slug) for the site, for example:
yourbusiness.bizuply.com

Before publishing, make sure:
• Business and contact details are up to date
• There are quality images
• A contact or booking button is active
• SEO settings are filled in

seo.question: How do I set SEO for the website?
seo.answer:
In the site editor, open SEO settings:

• Title — up to 60 characters, including the business name and a keyword
• Meta Description — up to 160 characters about the services
• Keywords — 3–5 words relevant to your field

You can also set FAQ schema to improve appearance on Google.

manageMultiple.question: How do I manage multiple websites?
manageMultiple.answer:
In "My Sites" you can:
• See all sites — live and drafts
• Organize sites into folders
• Duplicate, rename, or delete a site
• Share a link to a published site
• Edit each site separately

notSaving.question: What should I do if changes are not saving?
notSaving.answer:
Try the following steps:

• Check your internet connection
• Click "Save" again in the editor
• Hard refresh (Ctrl + F5)
• Clear browser cache
• Try another browser

If the issue continues, contact support with details and a screenshot.

notLoading.question: The site does not load after publishing — what should I do?
notLoading.answer:
• Make sure the site status is "Active" and not "Draft"
• Wait 2–5 minutes for updates
• Try opening in a private / Incognito window
• Check that the slug (address) is correct
• Refresh the page

If it still does not work, contact technical support.

editAfterPublish.question: Can I edit the site after publishing?
editAfterPublish.answer:
Yes. Open the site from "My Sites" → "Edit", make changes, then click "Save" and "Publish" again.

Changes will update on the live site within a few minutes.

share.question: How do I share the website with customers?
share.answer:
After publishing:
• Copy the link from "My Sites" or the "Share" button
• Send it via WhatsApp, social media, email signature, or business card
• Add the link to your Bizuply business profile

The dashboard will show view and traffic statistics for the site.

notLoading.question: The system does not load — what should I do?
notLoading.answer:
When the system does not load, follow these steps in order:

1. Check the internet connection: make sure the device is connected and the signal is stable. Try opening another site.
2. Refresh the page: press F5 (Windows) or Cmd + R (Mac).
3. Clear the browser cache: Chrome → Settings → Privacy and security → Clear browsing data. Select cached images/files and cookies, then clear.
4. Sign out and sign back in: wait 2–3 minutes before signing in again.
5. Try another browser or device: Firefox, Edge, Safari, or a different device.
6. Disable extensions: temporarily turn off ad blockers or security add-ons.

If the issue continues, contact support with screenshots and browser/OS details.

server500.question: I got a 500 server error — what should I do?
server500.answer:
A 500 error means a server-side problem. Try:

1. Refresh the page.
2. Clear cache and cookies.
3. Wait a few minutes and try again.
4. Check from another browser or device.
5. Disable extensions that block content.

If it continues, contact support with screenshots, the time it happened, and browser/OS details.

cannotLogin.question: I cannot sign in — what can I do?
cannotLogin.answer:
If you cannot sign in:

1. Check the username/password and keyboard language.
2. Use Forgot password.
3. Check spam for the reset email.
4. Wait 15 minutes if the account was locked temporarily.
5. Try incognito mode or another browser.

If sign-in still fails, contact support with the account details.

filesNotLoading.question: Files do not load or display — what should I do?
filesNotLoading.answer:
If files do not load:

1. Confirm a supported format (JPG, PNG, PDF, MP4).
2. Confirm the file is within the allowed size.
3. Check that the file is not damaged.
4. Refresh and try again.
5. Try another browser or a private window.
6. Contact support with the error details.

autoLogout.question: The system signs me out automatically — what should I do?
autoLogout.answer:
Unexpected sign-outs can come from:

1. An unstable internet connection.
2. Browser cache or extension conflicts.
3. Power-saving or sleep settings.
4. VPN or proxy interference.

Try another browser or device and contact support if it continues.

reportBugs.question: How do I report bugs in the system?
reportBugs.answer:
For an effective bug report:

1. Describe the action that caused the issue.
2. Attach screenshots.
3. Include device, OS, browser, and version.
4. Note the date and time.
5. Send details to support@bizuply.com or open a support ticket.

accountBlocked.question: My account was blocked for no reason — what should I do?
accountBlocked.answer:
If the account is blocked:

1. Confirm the block by trying to sign in.
2. Check email (including spam).
3. Contact support with the account details.
4. Describe the last actions before the block.

blankScreen.question: I see a blank page or white screen — how do I fix it?
blankScreen.answer:
To fix blank screens:

1. Check the internet connection.
2. Clear cache and cookies.
3. Temporarily disable extensions.
4. Try incognito mode.
5. Try another browser or device.

timeout.question: Timeout error — the site disconnects or does not respond
timeout.answer:
A timeout usually means a slow or interrupted connection.

1. Check internet speed and stability.
2. Close apps that use a lot of bandwidth.
3. Refresh and try again.
4. Try later if servers are busy.
5. Contact support if it keeps happening.

getHelp.question: How do I get technical help?
getHelp.answer:
For fast technical help we recommend:

• Help center and FAQ: review guides and common solutions.
• Support bot: use the built-in bot for routine issues.
• Self-service: refresh, clear cache, or reset the password.
• Contact support: email support@bizuply.com and include screenshots, browser, device, and the time of the issue.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset a password?
resetPassword.answer:
To reset a password:

1. Go to the sign-in page.
2. Click Forgot password.
3. Enter the account email.
4. Check inbox and spam.
5. Open the reset link.
6. Set and confirm a new password.

If the email does not arrive, confirm the address and try again or contact support.

notifications.question: How do notifications work in the system?
notifications.answer:
Notifications are sent automatically for key events such as collaborations, appointments, and system updates.

They appear under the bell icon in the top corner.

No manual setup is required. Push notifications depend on browser or device permissions.

noUpdates.question: Why am I not seeing new updates in the system?
noUpdates.answer:
• Check that the internet connection is stable.
• Refresh the page (F5 / Cmd + R).
• Clear the browser cache.
• Make sure the browser or app is up to date.
• Try another browser or device.

If it continues, contact support with device and browser details.

clearCache.question: How do I clear cache and cookies?
clearCache.answer:
In Google Chrome:

1. Open the menu → Settings.
2. Go to Privacy and security.
3. Choose Clear browsing data.
4. Select All time.
5. Check cookies and cached files.
6. Click Clear data and restart the browser.

The process is similar in Firefox, Edge, and Safari.

slowSite.question: What should I do if the site is slow or freezes?
slowSite.answer:
• Check internet speed and stability.
• Close background apps.
• Clear the browser cache.
• Try another browser.
• Make sure the OS and browser are up to date.

If performance issues continue, contact support with details.

myProblemOrSystem.question: How do I know if the problem is on my side or in the system?
myProblemOrSystem.answer:
• Try another device.
• Try another network.
• Clear cache and disable extensions.
• Check firewall or security software.

If the issue appears everywhere, it is likely on the system side. Contact support with your findings.

oldBrowsers.question: Does the system support old browsers?
oldBrowsers.answer:
The system is built for modern browsers to keep performance, security, and stability.

Old browsers can cause display errors, slow performance, or missing features.

We strongly recommend updating the browser or switching to a supported one.

accountSecurity.question: What should I do if there is an account security problem?
accountSecurity.answer:
• Change the password immediately.
• Review account activity.
• Disconnect unknown devices.
• Use strong unique passwords.
• Run an antivirus check on the device.

If you cannot access the account, contact support immediately.

recoverAccount.question: How do I recover an account if I forgot the sign-in details?
recoverAccount.answer:
• Use Forgot password.
• Search old emails from the system for username hints.
• Contact support with identifying details if recovery fails.

getLeads.question: How do I get leads into the CRM?
getLeads.answer:
To get leads into the Bizuply CRM:

1. Go to CRM → Leads.
2. Make sure a published site has a contact form — site leads enter automatically.
3. To connect Meta Lead Ads: CRM → Settings → Meta Lead Ads connection.
4. You can also add a lead manually in the Leads tab.

New leads appear in the CRM and dashboard, and you can update status (new, in progress, converted, and more).

bookAppointment.question: How do I book an appointment for a customer?
bookAppointment.answer:
To book an appointment:

1. Go to CRM → Appointments.
2. Click New appointment (+).
3. Choose an existing customer — or add a new one.
4. Choose a service, date, and available time.
5. Click Save.

The appointment syncs with the calendar, and you can send a reminder.

whatIsCrm.question: What is a CRM and how does it help run the business?
whatIsCrm.answer:
A CRM (customer relationship management) system keeps customer relationships in one place.

It lets you:
• Store and organize customer information
• Track appointments, services, and interactions
• Improve communication and retention
• Analyze customer behavior and performance
• Make data-based business decisions

In BizUply the CRM is fully integrated with appointments, the dashboard, and analytics.

clientProfile.question: What data is in a customer profile and how do I use it?
clientProfile.answer:
A customer profile includes contact details, service and purchase history, upcoming and past appointments, notes, and an interaction log.

Use it to personalize service, improve retention, spot sales opportunities, reduce no-shows with reminders, and improve internal coordination.

scheduling.question: How are scheduling and bookings managed in the CRM?
scheduling.answer:
Scheduling is managed in a dedicated interface that shows all bookings and availability.

Features include adding, editing, and cancelling appointments, automatic customer alerts, calendar sync, optional prepayments, and reminder messages.

editCancel.question: Can I edit or cancel existing bookings, and how does it work?
editCancel.answer:
Yes. Edit or cancel bookings directly from the scheduling interface.

The system notifies customers automatically, keeps a full history, and updates availability in real time.

To reduce cancellations: use reminders, set a clear cancellation policy, and offer flexible rescheduling.

services.question: How do I add or update services and products in the CRM?
services.answer:
Services are managed in the Services tab.

You can set a description, price, duration, and special terms.

Accurate service setup prevents scheduling clashes and improves the customer experience.

clientList.question: How do I manage the customer list and run searches?
clientList.answer: The Customers tab provides a full list, advanced search and filters, appointment and communication history, notes, and status marks.

dataNotUpdating.question: What should I do if data is not updating or there is a system issue?
dataNotUpdating.answer:
Try a hard refresh (Ctrl + F5 / Cmd + Shift + R), check the internet, sign out and back in, clear cache and cookies, try another browser or device, and look for maintenance messages.

If it continues, contact support with screenshots and details.

analyze.question: How do I analyze and improve customer performance with the CRM?
analyze.answer: CRM analytics help you spot high-value customers, track campaign responses, improve service response times, detect churn risk early, create tailored offers, and set KPIs.

crmVsBooking.question: What is the difference between a CRM and an appointments-only system?
crmVsBooking.answer:
An appointments system focuses only on scheduling and time.

A CRM adds full customer profiles, interaction history, reports, automatic reminders, and marketing/retention tools.

Together they are a complete business-management solution.

errors.question: What should I do if I hit errors in the CRM or appointments system?
errors.answer: Check the internet, refresh, look at maintenance messages, confirm the input is accurate, document the issue with screenshots, and contact support with full details.

whatShows.question: What does my business dashboard show?
whatShows.answer:
The dashboard is a real-time control center for business activity.

It includes appointments by status, review and rating trends, profile views, visual charts, and an interactive calendar.

viewAppointments.question: How do I see all appointments scheduled for the week or month?
viewAppointments.answer: In the Appointments section you can use a monthly calendar, daily lists with customer and service details, a sortable table, and Excel/PDF export.

notUpdating.question: What should I do if appointments or views are not updating on the dashboard?
notUpdating.answer: Check the internet, hard-refresh, clear cache and cookies, try another browser or device, sign out and back in, wait 5–10 minutes for sync, and look for maintenance messages. If it continues, contact support.

calendar.question: What does the dashboard calendar represent?
calendar.answer: The calendar is a visual overview of scheduled appointments. A marked day means at least one appointment. Click a day to see hourly appointments and move between months to plan ahead.

clientsChart.question: How do I read the chart of customers who booked by month?
clientsChart.answer: The chart shows how many customers booked appointments each month. It is available as bars, a line, or a table, and helps spot seasonal peaks for marketing and budgeting.

smartTips.question: What are the smart action recommendations on the dashboard?
smartTips.answer: Smart recommendations are generated from system analytics: promote a service when activity drops, ask for reviews, optimize the schedule, and improve customer engagement. They update in real time from your data.

wrongData.question: What should I do if I notice wrong or missing dashboard data?
wrongData.answer: Confirm appointments and statuses are correct, check for sync issues, refresh or sign in again, review system messages, and if it continues report with screenshots to support.

summary.question: How do I get a weekly or monthly business summary?
summary.answer: The dashboard provides summary reports with total appointments, profile-exposure metrics, and a reviews overview. You can view them online, download PDF or Excel, and share with the team.

notRealtime.question: What if dashboard data is not updating in real time?
notRealtime.answer: If data looks stale: check the internet, hard-refresh, clear cache and cookies, try another browser or device, look for maintenance alerts, sign out and back in, and wait a few minutes for sync. Contact support if it continues.

improve.question: How do I improve dashboard metrics and increase business activity?
improve.answer: Run focused marketing campaigns, keep a current professional profile, add quality photos and videos, manage availability and reduce no-shows, ask customers for reviews, analyze trends, and use CRM and analytics well.

tabs.question: How do I use the tabs on the business page?
tabs.answer:
The BizUply business page is a site you build and manage in the website builder. Tabs keep the information organized.

Home: overview — name, description, and contact.
Gallery: photos and videos.
Reviews: customer ratings and performance.
FAQ: common questions answered by the owner.
Calendar: appointments and service bookings.

Each tab gives visitors and the owner a focused, easy view.

changesNotShowing.question: What if my changes do not appear on the business page?
changesNotShowing.answer: After saving, try a hard refresh (Ctrl + F5 / Cmd + Shift + R), clear cache and cookies, check the internet, try another browser or device, wait 5–10 minutes, then sign out and back in. If it continues, contact support with screenshots.

editDetails.question: How do I add or edit business details?
editDetails.answer: Open the business page editor from the dashboard. You can update the name, description, phone, email, city, category, logo, and gallery. Click Save changes to apply.

gallery.question: How do I manage the business photo gallery?
gallery.answer:
Main gallery: up to 5 primary photos on the profile.
Extended gallery: more photos and videos under the Gallery tab.
Use quality images and keep the content current.

categoryLocation.question: Why do the business category and location matter?
categoryLocation.answer: Accurate category and location improve visibility and relevance: more exposure, more inquiries, better conversion, and better collaboration matches. Wrong settings can hide the business.

accessIssue.question: What if I cannot access the business page or the system?
accessIssue.answer: Check the internet, try another browser, clear cache and cookies, hard-refresh, and try another device or network. If it continues, contact support with screenshots.

videos.question: How do I add videos to the business page, and why?
videos.answer: Add videos in the Gallery tab. They show services visually, build trust, and raise engagement. Use MP4 and stay within the size limit.

services.question: How do I add services or service categories?
services.answer: Services and categories are managed from the Calendar tab and the CRM. That improves booking, organization, marketing, and conversions.

contactDetails.question: How do I manage and customize contact details?
contactDetails.answer: Contact details are managed in the dashboard and site editor. You can update phone, email, and address, add social links, and control what the public sees.

uploadSave.question: What if image uploads or saving changes fail?
uploadSave.answer: Check file format (JPG/PNG, MP4), size limits, hard-refresh, cache, internet, another browser, and that you clicked Save. If it continues, contact support with screenshots.

whatIs.question: What is a business collaboration and how can it grow the business?
whatIs.answer:
A collaboration is two or more businesses working together on marketing, sales, or services.

Benefits: wider reach, shared marketing cost, new audiences, more trust, and a better customer experience.

Choose partners with matching values and goals.

publish.question: How do I publish a new collaboration offer on BizUply?
publish.answer: Fill the collaboration form with a clear title and description, what you offer and expect, plus contact, budget, and an expiry date. Offers are then matched to relevant businesses by category, location, and type.

choosePartner.question: How do I find and choose the right collaboration partner?
choosePartner.answer: Match values and goals, complementary audiences, reputation, added value, and a kickoff meeting for roles. Track KPIs so the collaboration stays on course.

manageWell.question: What are the best ways to manage collaborations?
manageWell.answer: Set goals and KPIs, assign roles, agree timelines, keep records, communicate clearly, track results, and handle issues early. BizUply has tools for structured collaboration.

received.question: How do I view and manage incoming collaboration offers?
received.answer: In Received offers you can view, filter, and search incoming proposals, judge fit, budget, and timeline, then approve or decline. Fast professional replies raise success.

sent.question: What are Sent offers and how do I manage them?
sent.answer: Sent offers are the proposals you sent to other businesses. Track replies, keep notes, set follow-up reminders, and stay proactive in negotiation.

expiry.question: Do collaboration offers expire?
expiry.answer: Yes. You can set an expiry and optional start/end dates. That keeps offers controlled, professional, and flexible. BizUply also supports digital agreements and e-signatures.

cannotSend.question: What if I cannot send or publish a collaboration?
cannotSend.answer: Fill required fields, check the internet, hard-refresh, try another browser, confirm permissions, and look for maintenance messages. Contact support if it continues.

communicate.question: How do I communicate with a potential partner?
communicate.answer: Use the contact details on the offer, BizUply messaging, meetings as needed, and keep written notes of agreements. Clear, professional communication is essential.

disputes.question: How should I handle disputes in collaborations?
disputes.answer: Stay transparent, keep written agreements, set ground rules early, track expectations, mediate if needed, and hold review meetings. BizUply tools help track and resolve issues.

whatIs.question: What is the business advisor and how can it help me?
whatIs.answer:
The BizUply advisor is AI business and marketing guidance from your real data: analysis, tailored recommendations, copy-ready wording, and planning.

It does not run actions. Build those in Automations / AI Automations.

whereAutomations.question: Where do I build AI automations?
whereAutomations.answer:
Build them in the existing automation builder:

1. Open the AI Automations tab inside the advisor.
2. Pick an AI recipe (for example lead scoring or call summaries).
3. The builder opens with the recipe ready to edit.

The advisor recommends. Automations execute.

readyOrFree.question: How do I pick a ready question or ask a free question?
readyOrFree.answer:
Ready questions give fast focused tips (what to do today, leads to handle, follow-up copy).
Free questions get a tailored answer and next-step ideas — without running automations.
For automatic execution, go to AI Automations.

allBusinesses.question: Do the answers fit every type of business?
allBusinesses.answer: The advisor uses AI plus your real business data: profile, performance history, current activity, and goals. Complex legal or financial topics may still need a human expert.

notInList.question: What if my question is not in the list?
notInList.answer: Ask anything in the free input. The advisor analyzes it in real time, answers, and suggests next steps you can do manually or turn into an automation.

available247.question: Is the service available 24/7?
available247.answer: Yes. The advisor is available 24/7 for guidance, so you can decide faster at any hour.

maximize.question: How do I get the most from the business advisor?
maximize.answer: Apply recommendations daily, build AI automations for repeat work, track results, and ask follow-up questions. The advisor advises. Automations execute.

viewMessages.question: How can I view messages with clients?
viewMessages.answer:
In Client Messages you can see every client with an active conversation.

• Chats are ordered by most recent activity
• Messages update in real time
• Click a client to open the full history
• Conversations are saved for later review

sendNew.question: How do I send a new message to a client?
sendNew.answer: Select the client, type in the input, then click Send or press Enter. Messages are delivered instantly. You can also attach files, images, and links.

notSent.question: What should I do if a message is not sent?
notSent.answer: Check the internet, hard-refresh, look for maintenance notices, try another browser, and confirm attachments meet size and format limits. Contact support if it continues.

readReceipt.question: How will I know if the client has read my message?
readReceipt.answer: The system does not show read receipts. Chats update in real time and you can see when the client replies or starts typing. If confirmation is critical, ask directly or use another channel.

historical.question: Can I view historical messages with clients?
historical.answer: Yes. All messages are stored. Scroll older chats, search by keyword or date, and keep continuity with each client.

notUpdating.question: What if client messages are not updating in real time?
notUpdating.answer: Check the internet, refresh, clear cache and cookies, try another browser or device, and look for maintenance. Contact support with screenshots if it continues.

sendFiles.question: Can I send files or links in messages?
sendFiles.answer: Yes: documents (PDF, DOC), images (JPG, PNG), and external links. Stay within the size limit (usually up to 5MB) and supported formats.

mistaken.question: How do I handle incorrect or duplicate messages sent by mistake?
mistaken.answer: Messages cannot be edited or deleted after sending. Send a clarification, apologize if needed, and review carefully before the next send.

listNotLoad.question: What if the chat or client list does not load?
listNotLoad.answer: Check the internet, refresh, clear cache and cookies, try another browser or device, and look at system status. Contact support with screenshots and timing if it continues.

multiple.question: Can I manage multiple client conversations at the same time?
multiple.answer: Yes. Switch from the side list, get new-message notifications, and keep chats open. That improves response speed.

faqSection.title: What's important to know before you start

code.q: Do I need to know how to code to build a site on BizUply?
code.a: No. Choose one of the 205 templates, click any element, and change it in place — text, color, image, and spacing. Anyone who does want to go deeper can add their own CSS and HTML tags to the site's head and body.

structure.q: Can I change the site's structure and not just the content?
structure.a: Yes. The layers panel lets you drag sections and reorder them, add and delete pages and sub-pages, set a home page, and hide pages from the menu — and the menu updates accordingly.

domain.q: Where is the site published, and can I connect a private domain?
domain.a: Every site gets its own address under sites.bizuply.com. You can also search for and buy a domain directly from within the system and connect it to the site, or connect an existing domain and disconnect it at any time.

crm.q: Do inquiries from the site reach the CRM?
crm.a: Yes. The site's lead forms are set to send every inquiry directly to the CRM lead pipeline with the source "Website", including an email alert, an automatic reply to whoever left the inquiry, and the option to require a phone field.

sell.q: Can I sell from the site?
sell.a: Yes. Enable the store plugin, manage the products from the site panel, and visitors get a shopping cart and checkout. Payments go through a provider you connect — Stripe, PayPal, Tranzila, Max/Hyp, Grow, or Morning.

collaborate.q: Can I give a designer or partner access to the site?
collaborate.a: Yes. You can invite people to the site with edit or view permissions, see who's connected, and remove access — and also transfer full ownership of the site to another user.

analytics.q: How do I know if the site is working?
analytics.a: The dashboard shows page views, unique visitors, top pages, and traffic sources (including UTM), so you can see where visitors come from and where they land.

buildBusiness.title: Editing the business page in Bizuply
buildBusiness.whyTitle: Why editing the business page matters
buildBusiness.why1: Your Bizuply business page is more than a digital profile — it is your virtual store. With the site builder, ready templates, and AI Studio you can create a professional presence. This is where potential customers form a first impression, understand your services, and decide to contact you or book.
buildBusiness.why2: A clear, well-built page builds trust, reduces friction, and increases conversions. Every section helps guide customers to act.
buildBusiness.nameBody: The name appears in search results, at the top of the page, and wherever the business is shown. Keep it clear, professional, and descriptive.
buildBusiness.nameTip1: Use the official business name or your personal brand.
buildBusiness.nameTip2: Include the main specialty to improve clarity and search visibility.
buildBusiness.nameEx2: Michael Levy — plumbing and emergency service
buildBusiness.descBody: Explain who you are, what you offer, and why customers should choose you. This is one of the most influential parts of the page.

buildBusiness.include4: What sets you apart from competitors
buildBusiness.contactBody: Accurate contact details make it easy for customers to reach you. Double-check phone numbers and emails so you do not miss opportunities.
buildBusiness.categoryBody: Choose the category that best represents your main service. If you offer several services, focus on the keyword customers are most likely to search.
buildBusiness.areaBody: Choose the main city or service area. If you cover several areas, pick the one where most of the work happens.
buildBusiness.galleryBody: The gallery lets customers judge your work visually before they contact you. Quality photos and videos raise trust and engagement.
buildBusiness.rec3: Short videos that show your process or professionalism
buildBusiness.galleryTip1: Use high-resolution photos with good lighting.
buildBusiness.galleryTip3: Avoid heavy filters so the work stays authentic.

system.title: BizUply system settings
system.subtitle: Learn how the BizUply system works and how to manage platform settings effectively.

whatAre.question: What are system settings in BizUply?
whatAre.answer: System settings let you manage BizUply's central configuration, including preferences, permissions, and internal tools that affect how the business runs.

whereManage.question: Where do you manage business and account preferences?
whereManage.answer: You can manage business profile details, contact details, visibility settings, and general preferences directly from the dashboard. Changes apply in real time across the platform.

whichTools.question: Which tools are part of the BizUply system?
whichTools.answer: BizUply includes a business website builder, dashboard and analytics, CRM, business collaborations, an AI advisor, and internal system configuration tools.

dataSecurity.question: How does BizUply handle data security and privacy?
dataSecurity.answer: BizUply is built with strong security practices, including access control, secure data handling, and system-level protections to protect business information.

permissions.question: Can you control permissions and access inside the system?
permissions.answer: Yes. BizUply provides controlled access to system features based on the account and business configuration. Additional permissions may depend on your plan.

changeImpact.question: How do system changes affect the dashboard and tools?
changeImpact.answer: System updates are reflected immediately in the dashboard, CRM, website builder, AI advisor, and collaboration tools to keep everything consistent.

somethingWrong.question: What should I do if something does not work as expected?
somethingWrong.answer: Try refreshing the page and checking the connection. If the issue continues, go to the "Troubleshooting and errors" section or contact technical support.

autoUpdates.question: Do system features update automatically?
autoUpdates.answer: Yes. BizUply publishes improvements and system updates regularly and automatically to ensure stability, performance, and new capabilities.
